newsitem.title: UK: S&P may cut, raise MCI ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P may cut, raise MCI ratings.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it has placed AAA senior unsecured debt ratings of British Telecommunications Plc and related entities on CreditWatch with negative implications.
At the same time, S&P said it placed A long-term and A1 short-term ratings of MCI Communications Corp (MCI) on CreditWatch with positive implications.
BT's A1 plus commercial paper rating is affirmed, S&P said in a statement.
"The rating actions follow the announcement that BT and MCI plan to merge, creating a telecoms operator with approximately 43 million customers in 70 countries to be called Concert," S&P said.

"Though Concert's financial profile on a pro forma basis is expected to remain strong following the merger, the group will face significant capital investment needs and a higher industry risk than BT is currently exposed to," S&P said.
"Concert will be one of the largest global telecoms groups, well placed to benefit from structural changes underway in the industry," S&P said.
CreditWatch listings will be resolved following meetings with the management of both companies, S&P said.
